report.speaker: Julien Sabin
report.title: L'énergie des gaz de bosons dilués
report.question: 三维零温排斥玻色气体在固定密度热力学极限之后，如何在稀薄极限获得由散射长度决定的能量首项和 Lee–Huang–Yang 修正，而不假定一般热力学凝聚已获证明？
report.source_version: Official June 2026 report, no numbered revision, 29 pages; SHA-256 45f8a22a4b1ec5d2bff6677f62aa3146cfe632eb7dd6d8a4f96e7ba19fa788dd
report.reading_scope: Read the complete 29-page official report, including introduction, sections 1-7 and bibliography, through local pdftotext extraction. Visually inspected page 1256-04 to confirm conjugation and the printed single-excitation example. Independently recomputed selected elementary calculations. Read selected sections and theorem statements of the primary papers below, not their full technical proofs.
deferred: The weighted Poincare and Sobolev compactness proof of the two-particle lower bound in Sabin Proposition 2.1 is cited rather than locally reconstructed.
Closed-form representation, thermodynamic-limit existence and boundary-condition independence remain external analytic inputs.
The full two-scale kinetic localization, high-moment excitation bounds, c-number error estimates and soft-pair estimates in Fournais-Solovej I and II are not locally proved.
The hard-core approximation theorem and uniform parameter choices are cited; the elementary hard-core scattering computation does not replace these many-body arguments.
The 2021 upper-bound trial-state construction is not reproduced.
The September 2026 upper-bound preprint is recorded separately from the June report; only its introduction, model and Theorem 1.1 were read, not its full proof.
General thermodynamic Bose-Einstein condensation is not deduced from the energy asymptotics.
Positive-temperature, two-dimensional and third-order energy results are outside this branch.

entries: 专题叙述从乘积态能量缺陷推进到散射、次阶积分与多体误差；八个段落均有正文链接，导航不登记为数学前提。
定义归一化对称多粒子波函数，复用 L2、Hilbert 张量积和纯态射线。
一个同轨道乘积态例子，直接核对对称性和归一化。
定义有限动能函数空间及弱偏导，明确三种边界形式域的区别。
定义多体能量形式，区分形式表达式、自伴定义域和硬核排除条件；表示定理明确外引。
定义基态能量及其变分上、下界的量词差别。
定义固定密度的热力学能量密度；存在性和边界独立性单独标为外部输入。
定义无量纲稀薄参数，计算散射长度、粒子间距和愈合尺度的比例并说明单位。
定义单轨道占据数并核对其投影表达与范围。
定义宏观占据凝聚，允许箱子与轨道变化，保留报告猜想与能量定理的区分。
单激发例子证明完全凝聚不等于多体范数接近乘积态；距离重新算为 sqrt(2)。
逐个动能与粒子对计算乘积态能量，给出有边界控制的 Hartree 上界。
质心坐标计算解释散射势的二分之一以及物理动能常数，避免单位混用。
定义散射变分常数及非紧支径向势的截断延拓；存在性和逼近理论明确引用。
由径向散射方程计算尾部、通量和能量，极小解及 Sobolev 逼近作为明确输入。
方势垒通过匹配径向解计算散射长度，核对弱势展开与无限势高极限。
硬核变分例子以径向试探函数和逐射线 Schwarz 下界得到排除半径。
以小幅试探函数证明第一 Born 值严格偏大；非零条件明确为不几乎处处为零。
精确陈述两粒子大箱极限，区分本地上界计算与引用的加权紧性下界。
相关试探函数证明两粒子 limsup 上界，展示归一化和立方箱差变量体积权重。
在下界与上界假设的交集上陈述双边 LHY 公式，不把模型积分写成多体证明。
精确记录含硬核和衰减条件的一侧下界及非紧支势散射长度的定义。
将九月预印本上界与六月报告分开，保留偶势上界和径向势下界的假设差别。
定义变粒子数的玻色 Fock 空间、真空和粒子数分量，不重复 Hilbert 定义。
定义占据数基上的产生湮灭操作及共同稠密定义域。
逐占据向量证明正则对易关系与常数项的来源，显式链接线性张成。
双模配方与压缩真空证明精确基态能量，显式处理负 B 和 B=0。
证明反项积分的收敛、归一化及 LHY 数值系数，解释双动量计数而不偷换多体模型。
通过一个原函数和两端极限计算唯一的无量纲径向积分。
散射方程给出重整化势的积分和二阶 Born 补偿项抵消。
从明确给定的单粒子谱隙推出多体激发数界；Neumann Poincare 不等式注明输入。
证明带空箱项的化学势分箱下界，保留 Neumann 形式域与非负势的作用。
用两个余项量级证明粗界无法同时达到 LHY 精度，不将粗界矛盾误说成实际余项下界。
说明双重局域化和软配对控制承担的数学任务；技术定理身份明确，不列为本地证明。
定义单模相干态并核对其归一化与湮灭算子特征值。
以复平面高斯矩证明恒等分解及二次、四次上符号的低阶修正。
保留报告和四篇主要论文的作者、精确版本、页码及许可边界；九月结果单列。

external_input_details.0Q04: Nonnegative closed-form representation and singular-potential Hilbert subspace: Fournais-Solovej II Remark 1.9.
external_input_details.0Q06: Thermodynamic limit: Sabin Proposition 1.9 citing Ruelle Theorem 3.5.11; Ruelle not independently read. Boundary independence: Fournais-Solovej I section 1.
external_input_details.0Q0D: Existence and smooth approximation for bounded compact potentials: Sabin Remark 2.2 and the scattering theory recalled in Fournais-Solovej I section 2 / II section 3. Noncompact definition directly checked in II equation (3.12).
external_input_details.0Q0E: Existence and homogeneous Sobolev density invoked explicitly; radial flux, energy and variational comparison are locally written.
external_input_details.0Q0F: Explicit ODE solution and matching are local; equivalence to the variational length uses 0Q0E.
external_input_details.0Q0G: Elementary ray inequality is local; extension to weak finite-energy functions uses exterior Sobolev trace/approximation.
external_input_details.0Q0J: Trial-state computation is local; identification of the infimum over smooth compact functions uses scattering density theory.
external_input_details.0Q0T: Algebra and radial Newton-potential formula are local; scattering solution properties use 0Q0E.
external_input_details.0Q0U: Abstract spectral-gap implication is locally proved; Neumann cube Poincare inequality is the stated one-particle input.
external_input_details.0Q0I: The matching lower bound is Sabin Proposition 2.1, including weighted Poincare and Sobolev compactness.
external_input_details.0Q0K: Fournais-Solovej I Theorem 1.2 lower bound combined with Basti-Cenatiempo-Schlein 2101.06222v3 Theorem 1.1 upper bound.
external_input_details.0Q0L: Fournais-Solovej II Theorems 1.1 and 1.3; approximation input Theorem 1.6.
external_input_details.0Q0M: Basti-Brooks-Cenatiempo-Olgiati-Schlein 2609.25314v1 Theorem 1.1, preprint statement only, no independent proof validation.
external_input_details.0Q0X: External technical modules: Fournais-Solovej I section 5 and Appendix B, Theorems 5.8 and 11.4, section 12. The note describes their role and does not assert a local proof.

source_corrections_and_normalizations: The normalized symmetrized one-excitation vector has norm-distance sqrt(2), not 1, from the normalized product state. Sabin page 4 was visually checked; 0Q0A gives the full calculation.
Use alpha=B/(A+sqrt(A^2-B^2)) in 0Q0Q, permitting negative B and B=0; do not repeat the report's blanket alpha in [0,1) when B may be negative.
The small-box infimum includes n=0 because empty boxes occur. This is made explicit in 0Q0V.
Single-particle kinetic operator is -Delta; relative operator is -2Delta; kappa=sqrt(V0/2); a=R-tanh(kappa R)/kappa.
Full momentum integral carries 1/2 to avoid counting both k and -k twice; s=8*pi*a*rho; I(s)=2*sqrt(2)*s^(5/2)/(15*pi^2).
Nonzero repulsive potentials in strict inequalities mean not almost everywhere zero, and the exact 1-a/r exterior tail is asserted only for radial finite-range potentials.
Only fixed bounded radial compact potentials are used for the June-era double-sided theorem; September 2026 general-potential progress is kept separately dated.
